title: experienced
text: Really fun experience! The pace of the bike tour was relaxed, so we could enjoy the city without feeling rushed. The tapas stop was a great bonus and a nice way to finish the tour.
author: 849ibnum

title: experienced
text: This was a great way to see Barcelona. The bike ride was easy and enjoyable, and stopping for tapas along the way made it even better. Highly recommend!
author: alexsW360VY

title: road to tapas
text: Had a great time getting to know new people! and stopping for some nice tapas. loved the Jamon croquettes
author: carlosvA9457AR

title: Not just a tour guide - now a friend!
text: Brandon was super friendly and can have a laugh too. He seems to have traveled everywhere and is very knowledgeable! Would recommend a tour with him for sure.
author: skylerk642

title: Solo travelers DO THIS
text: So I’ve been travelling Europe for quite a while, a few of my friends cancelled on me so I decided to go Solo travelling, being worried about travelling solo I decided to book this, but after meeting the guys I was more than happy. If you’re curious.. best time of my life I made some of the best people yet. Yes yes yes
author: judem459

title: Fun and Tasty!
text: Super fun time! The route we went on was so incredible and the food was tasty and new. Learned a lot. Special thank you to the guides for the memories!
author: javilopessii
